thread:
Maya (Finance): Kickoff: running a dry-run for a small pricing experiment to validate grandfathering behavior and invoice previews. Need owners for tagging, CSV diff, comms, and rollback gates.

Omar (Billing): I can do the CSV schema + diff. Do we want a dedicated column like `grandfathered`?

Maya (Finance): Yes — use `grandfathered=true|false`. Cohorts: legacy-monthly, legacy-annual, and <1% high-usage pilot. Tag accounts with acct.meta.pricing_cohort=gf-experiment-1.

Lina (RevOps): I'll draft the customer preview email and in-product banner. For the dry-run the copy should say "preview only, no charges". Also recommend 72h notice for any live change.

Dev (Product): Add `rate_version` and `grandfathered` to /billing and /account APIs so Console and exports can show exact behavior. Also include a small eval that simulates system-message-heavy traffic to catch token count shifts.

Raj (Billing Ops): Metering plan: emit `grandfathered` flag from stage aggregates via feature flag. Proration: annual customers remain on legacy rates until renewal unless they explicitly opt in. I'll add an invoicer guard.

Maya (Finance): Draft runbook:
- Tag cohorts in staging and smoke test
- Emit `grandfathered` flag in staged metering
- Produce invoice_preview CSV for last 30 days, include `grandfathered` and `rate_version`
- Run csv diff vs baseline and token reconciliation
- Canary 0.5% legacy-monthly for 24h, monitor invoice_preview_count, refunds, token_delta_pct
- Block if refunds > 3 or token_delta_pct > 6%
- Rollback: remove tags + regenerate previews + send support notices if needed

Omar (Billing): I'll post sample CSV by EOD: columns account_id, cycle_start, cycle_end, plan, applied_rate, grandfathered, invoice_preview_amount, tokens_billed. Will run `csvdiff` and post results.

Lina (RevOps): Drafts will be in the ticket. Suggest holding off public pricing page until dry-run passes.

BillingBot: Ticket FIN-5110 created: "grandfathering dry-run + invoice preview" by Maya (Finance). https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-5110

Dev (Product): Reminder: include the small system-message eval; sometimes batching changes alter token counts.

Raj (Billing Ops): Will instrument a reconcile job to flag accounts with >6% token difference and alert #billing-team.

Maya (Finance): Thanks — meeting tomorrow 11:00 to sign off canary window. Action items: Omar => CSV sample, Raj => feature flag + emitter, Lina => comms, Dev => API field PR.
